summary: Senior product manager for grid-scale battery storage sold to AI data center operators at Meta, Google, NVIDIA and Microsoft. 12 years across utility programs, HVAC design-build and lithium-ion storage, from systems engineering to product. Licensed PE with an MBA in product management and strategy.

Run the engineering program for battery, enclosure, PCS, controls, HVAC and fire systems from requirements to delivery.

Designed LG's first pre-integrated battery container, 2.86 MWh.

experience.title: Senior Grid Innovation Engineer

experience.title: Design-Build Engineering Manager, HVAC
